project_overview.project_name: Looking for a Full stack developer Python, FAST API to enhance an existing agent on our platform
project_overview.project_summary: This software / digital product project centers on Looking for a Full stack developer Python, FAST API to enhance an existing agent on our platform. The initial brief says: AI Full Stack Developer We're looking for an experienced full stack developer to continue enhancing our AI fashion platform: GIA Interactive Showroom | Generative Intelligent Assembly The platform is already live, so this is not a project from scratch. We're looking for someone who can build on the existing codebase Python and implement several new features related to AI, monetization, analytics, and integrations. The work sits mainly in Web design and development, Software development, Web, Mobile & Software Dev. Stable project themes include payments and billing, referral or affiliate tracking, analytics and reporting, outbound communication, application apis, ai-assisted workflow, web content and page delivery. The available evidence includes 117 conversation messages, 2 attachment files, 1 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .pdf, .md formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For engineering onboarding, the key task is to understand the product workflows, component boundaries, integrations, data responsibilities, and the evidence level behind each implementation claim before changing code. A repository link appears in the project evidence, but its contents could not be inspected in the current environment; implementation claims therefore remain limited to the local sources and conversation.

technical_constraints: This includes: * Developing an AI styling mood board feature where users can prompt the AI to generate complete fashion mood boards instead of only retrieving existing content.

Yes, the mood board is not a rocket science, bear in mind we do not use OPEN AI SOL 5.6, We use Avelin AI, I have free credits from the founder, the reasoning is very good, I wasn't expecting, even we replaced tavily api and exa.ai with it to retreive from the net.

also something very important, since Avelin AI API counts only the tokens the API uses, before we integrate Stripe we need to calculate the tokens usage per specific prompt and create the monetization tier, I hope you are familiar with that?
